import MilneLib.Sheaf.InvariantModuleSheafBaseChange
import MilneLib.Affine.GaloisStableSections
import MilneLib.Quotient.GaloisQuotient
import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientGlueRestriction

/-!
# Invariant module sheaves on stable affine overlaps

The scalar maps here are induced by actual section restrictions and the
restricted action on the section rings. Ordinary module base change and
equivariance of the module restriction are explicit inputs; extracting these
inputs from an equivariant quasicoherent sheaf is a separate step.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open MilneLib.GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.IsSeparated]
  (act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X)
  (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
  (i j : StableAffineOpen act)

local notation "pK" => p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
local notation "hK" => galois_action_comp_base act p hact
local notation "R" => X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op i.U)
local notation "T" => X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op (i.U ⊓ j.U))

/-- The overlap section algebra uses the actual restriction homomorphism. -/
@[reducible]
noncomputable def overlapSectionsAlgebra : Algebra R T :=
  (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show i.U ⊓ j.U ≤ i.U from inf_le_left)).op).hom.toAlgebra

/-- The algebra between fixed section rings is induced by equivariant
restriction of the original section rings. -/
@[reducible]
noncomputable def overlapFixedSectionsAlgebra :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
    Algebra (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
      (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
  exact (InvariantLocalization.equivariantFixedRingHom
    (k := K) (G := L ≃ₐ[K] L)
    (sectionsRestrictionAlgHom pK inf_le_left).toRingHom
    (sectionsRestrictionAlgHom_equivariant act pK hK i.stable
      (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_left)).toAlgebra

/-- The fixed scalar map agrees with restriction into the overlap sections. -/
theorem overlapFixedSections_isScalarTower :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := overlapSectionsAlgebra act i j
    letI := overlapFixedSectionsAlgebra act p hact i j
    IsScalarTower (FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
      (FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) T := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := overlapSectionsAlgebra act i j
  letI := overlapFixedSectionsAlgebra act p hact i j
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro a
  rfl

variable [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]

local notation "A" => FixedPoints.subalgebra K R (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
local notation "B" => FixedPoints.subalgebra K T (L ≃ₐ[K] L)

/-- On an actual stable affine overlap, an equivariant module restriction
which realizes ordinary base change identifies the restriction of the
associated invariant sheaf with the invariant sheaf of overlap sections. -/
noncomputable def invariantModuleTildeOverlapRestrictionIso :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
    letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
    letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
    letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
    letI := overlapSectionsAlgebra act i j
    letI := overlapFixedSectionsAlgebra act p hact i j
    letI := overlapFixedSections_isScalarTower act p hact i j
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK i.stable
      (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_left) :=
        overlapFixedRestrictionMap_isOpenImmersion act pK hK i j
    ∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [Module L M]
      [Module R M] [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower L R M]
      [IsScalarTower K R M] [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) M]
      [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) R M]
      (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [Module L N]
      [Module R N] [Module T N] [IsScalarTower K L N]
      [IsScalarTower L T N] [IsScalarTower K T N] [IsScalarTower R T N]
      [IsScalarTower A B N]
      [DistribMulAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) N] [SMulDistribClass (L ≃ₐ[K] L) T N]
      (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
      (_hf : ∀ (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (m : M), f (g • m) = g • f m)
      (_h : Function.Bijective (moduleBaseChangeMap R T M N f)),
      (tilde (ModuleCat.of A (invariantModule K L R M))).restrict
          (fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK i.stable
            (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_left) ≅
        tilde (ModuleCat.of B (invariantModule K L T N)) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra pK (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p i.U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p i.U
  letI := sections_isScalarTower K L p (i.U ⊓ j.U)
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act i.stable
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact i.stable
  letI := isSemilinear_sections K L act p hact (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK i.stable
  letI := sectionsSMulCommClass act pK hK (overlap_stable act i j)
  letI := overlapSectionsAlgebra act i j
  letI := overlapFixedSectionsAlgebra act p hact i j
  letI := overlapFixedSections_isScalarTower act p hact i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (fixedSectionsRestrictionMap act pK hK i.stable
    (overlap_stable act i j) inf_le_left) :=
      overlapFixedRestrictionMap_isOpenImmersion act pK hK i j
  intro M _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ N _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f hf h
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))) :=
    overlapFixedRestrictionMap_isOpenImmersion act pK hK i j
  exact invariantModuleTildeBaseChangeRestrictionIso K L R T M N f hf h

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen
